name: replication-thrash
description: Repeated slave disconnects during write load — system must converge after chaos stops

phases.name: phase3
phases.description: Convergence — no partitions, verify slave catches up

invariants: Reconnect count <= 12 after chaos stops (short partitions within backlog)
Slave offset converges within 15s of last partition
L0 recovers below 10 after load completes
ActiveRetries bounded to 80 (backpressure prevents retry storm)
Both master and slave pass DB.Check() integrity
